programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Peak Performance
programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba

Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little

programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither

programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM GURUDWARA SRI SIS GANJ SAHIB
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit

Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Wellbeing behind the wheel – The new Bentley Azure Range
programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: It's all about the letter "S" as Chef Robert Jewell cooks up tasty meals using shrimp and sausage. For his first recipe, Robert fries up turmeric-spiced sweet potato fritters with a shrimp centre. He takes this tantalizing appetizer to another level with a savoury lime soy dipping sauce. Next up, Robert makes an English breakfast strata. This sausage casserole is easily the BEST way to start your day. He layers the bottom of the dish with buttered sourdough slices, before adding crispy fried sausages, leeks and tomatoes. He then covers it in a creamy egg mixture, crumbles stilton on top and bakes it to golden brown. Finally, Robert combines shrimp and sausage into one flavourful dish.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Making dishes with the letter “W” could be seen as a real challenge, but Chef Lauren Gulyas has got it covered. Choosing water chestnut and watercress as her star ingredients, Chef Lauren begins by serving up an Asian inspired rice dish complete with crunchy water chestnuts. She starts off cooking rice in chicken broth, a great way to infuse the grain with a subtle savoury flavour. Sautéing celery, garlic, and onion in sesame oil adds a flavour kick. Throw in some ginger, veggies, and water chestnuts and enjoy the sound of the sizzle. Next up, Lauren puts a peppery twist on a classic recipe, linguine with watercress pesto. Then it's time for the grand finale, Chef Lauren uses both ingredients to create the ultimate culinary combination.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Tea and turkey are an unlikely combo for a meal, but Chef Robert Jewell is a creative force in the kitchen. First, he gives earl grey and lavender tea a sweet treatment by making a rich semifreddo. Robert creates a silky tea infused syrup, which he drizzles over a luxurious custard and tops with whipped cream. Robert punches up the colour by adding tart poached raspberries and vibrant violet lavender petals. Now, it's time for a real show stopper - saffron turkey kebabs with pomegranate rice. This is not your average turkey dinner. First, Robert marinates the turkey pieces in lime, yogourt and garlic. After infusing basmati rice with aromatic saffron and bay leaves, Robert tosses the rice with crunchy pine nuts and sweet pomegranate - the perfect bed for his grilled to- perfection turkey skewers. Robert then takes his culinary skills to the next level when he uses tea and turkey in one single delicious dish.

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S1:E10 Zip Zap Zooooom! - È il momento del Grande Rally Arcobaleno, una gara amichevole che attraversa tutto il Regno, ma Grizelda è così concentrata sulla vittoria da mettere nei guai gli altri corridori. True deve aiutare gli altri partecipanti e mostrare a Grizelda che cosa significhi davvero correre.

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S1:E1 Big Mossy Mess - Quando Bartleby porta a casa un po' di speciale muschio Zazoony, questo comincia improvvisamente a crescere a dismisura! Ora tocca a True fermarne la diffusione prima che il muschio ricopra l'intero Regno Arcobaleno.

programme.title: L'impiegato
programme.desc: Splendida commedia con Nino Manfredi. Estremamente ligio al lavoro, un giovane impiegato non si concede mai distrazioni di alcun genere, sfogando tutte le sue pulsioni più intime ed i suoi desideri di realizzazione con intensi sogni. Il suo mondo sembra sgretolarsi con l'arrivo di una donna a capo dell'azienda che metterà a soqquadro le sue abitudini. Diretta da Gianni Puccini.

programme.title: Le ore dell'amore
programme.desc: Dopo tre anni di convivenza, Gianni e Maretta decidono che è tempo di sposarsi. Ma il matrimonio trasforma la loro vita in una routine opprimente che mette presto a dura prova la sopportazione di Gianni e vanifica gli sforzi di Maretta. Per salvare la situazione, di comune accordo, decidono di tornare a vivere da amanti.

programme.title: Telefoni Bianchi
programme.desc: Nel vivace affresco diretto da Dino Risi, una giovane impiegata sogna di diventare attrice e entrare nel brillante ma ipocrita mondo del cinema dei "telefoni bianchi". Tra ambizioni, compromessi e seduzioni, scopre quanto sia fragile il confine tra successo e illusione. Risi offre una satira acuta sull'ascesa sociale e sul fascino ingannevole dello spettacolo.

programme.title: Amore mio aiutami
programme.desc: Giovanni e Raffaella sono una coppia affiatata da dieci anni. La relazione va però in crisi quando Raffaella s'innamora di Valerio, un piacente quarantenne. Raffaella è quindi invaghita della nuova fiamma ma, confidando nella comprensione del marito che si vanta da sempre del suo essere moderno, aperto e razionale, chiede il suo aiuto.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Ciao maschio

programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: Vita da cani

Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: And then I go
programme.desc: Edwin e Flake frequentano le scuole medie e soffrono di uno stato di ansia. Incompresi dalle loro famiglie e demoralizzati a scuola ogni giorno, la loro furia cova finché un'idea di vendetta non offre loro una terrificante liberazione.

programme.title: Micheal Jackson
programme.sub-title: Chi ha ucciso il re del pop
programme.desc: 25 giugno 2009. La morte di Michael Jackson sconvolge il mondo. Chi ha ucciso il re del pop? Sembra che ognuno abbia una sua teoria, dall'omicidio premeditato al tragico suicidio. Contiene interviste e testimonianze dirette di Jermaine e Tito Jackson, Elizabeth Taylor, Diana Ross e altri. Riprese di provini, video della vita privata, la telefonata al 911 e la cerimonia funebre. Attraverso gli alti e bassi della vita di Michael, questa 'inside story' esamina i fattori e gli eventi che hanno contribuito alla sua morte

programme.title: Bergman 100: La Vita, I Segreti, Il Genio
programme.desc: Il documentario ricostruisce un anno fondamentale nella vita di Ingmar Bergman, il maestro del cinema, focalizzandosi sugli eventi che segnarono la sua carriera, tra l'uscita di Il posto delle fragole e Il settimo sigillo. Un viaggio nella sua arte, i suoi segreti e il suo genio creativo.

programme.title: Di là dal Fiume
programme.desc: La vita crea molti ostacoli per il ragazzo di 12 anni - Tedo. Tedo appartiene alla generazione che è stata costretta allo sfollamento di massa a causa della guerra civile in Abkhazia, uno dei luoghi più belli della Georgia. La guerra civile ha portato via tutto ciò che aveva Tedo, anche la speranza. Il film racconta uno straordinario dramma interiore di un bambino, i suoi pensieri, sentimenti, passioni, dolori e sforzi per prendere le armi contro le difficoltà.

programme.title: Ladre per caso

programme.title: L'AMORE è UN GIOCO

programme.title: PAZZI DA AMARE

programme.title: MATRIMONIO PER FINTA

Poiché il programma si conclude con un matrimonio, lei è decisa a non sposarsi: per questo rintraccia il suo futuro “marito televisivo” e stringe con lui un accordo, andando avanti solo finché non avrà la possibilità di rilanciare la sua carriera. Ma Cupido ha altri piani...

programme.desc: Pellicola biografica sulla vita di Lane Frost, celebre campione del rodeo. Dalla gioventù, quando Lane, grazie agli insegnamenti del padre, inizia a frequentare le gare, fino a diventare il migliore del mondo.

programme.title: Chiedi Alla Polvere
programme.desc: Nella Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore italo-americano Arturo e la cameriera messicana Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere il romanzo della vita, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere. Una Roma di fine anni '50 nel classico con Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grande Vittorio De Sica.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: L'amore fa male
programme.desc: Germana ha una figlia e un sogno mai infranto di essere attrice. Amante di un ricco avvocato, incontra Gianmarco in una corsia d'ospedale e se ne innamora perdutamente. Corrisposta con altrettanta passione da Gianmarco, ignora che l'uomo sia padre, marito e amico di vecchia data di Elisabetta, una rigida vicina di casa. Davanti a una tavola imbandita s'incroceranno e risolveranno i loro destini.

programme.title: La ricerca del vero amore
programme.desc: Becks, una giornalista romantica decide di aiutare il suo migliore amico Casey alla ricerca del suo primo amore. In questo viaggio, entrambi scoprono di più l'uno dell'altro e Becks deve affrontare un dilemma: aiutare Casey o rischiare di aprirle il cuore.

programme.title: Addestramento d'amore
programme.desc: Dopo aver commesso 73 errori sui vigili del fuoco nel suo ultimo romanzo rosa, l'editrice di Jo, Diana, insiste affinché trascorra settimane a fare ricerche per il suo prossimo libro, allenandosi in un campo militare gestito dal fratello navy seal.

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe è una wedding planner di successo, ma suo padre le chiede aiuto al caffè di famiglia, lei torna felicemente nella sua città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon. Non sa che sua madre ha già assunto Will per aiutarla, un aspirante chef e, guarda caso, l'amore d'infanzia di Zoe! Le tensioni aumentano tra Zoe e Will, ma risolveranno le loro divergenze e troveranno l'amore perduto lungo la strada?

programme.title: Un Amore Indimenticabile
programme.desc: Lillian è una donna d'affari che trasforma le start-up in aziende di successo. Il suo ultimo cliente è una società chiamata "Love Subscription". Il passato doloroso di Lillian entrerà in conflitto con i suoi crescenti sentimenti per Grant, il fondatore di "Love Subscription"?

programme.title: Amore in ascolto
programme.desc: Peyton, produttrice di podcast, è costretta a trasformare Alex nella prossima star e creare lo show perfetto per salvare entrambe le loro carriere. Lo show consiste nel trovare il vero amore di Peyton. Ma mentre procedono, sono proprio loro due a trovare l'amore.

programme.title: Il Gala dell'Amore
programme.desc: Quando a Kate viene affidato il compito di pianificare la Garden Gala di sua madre, il più grande evento di celebrazione dell'anno, deve scendere a compromessi con il nuovo e contraddittorio manager del giardino botanico.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'improvviso
programme.desc: Per beneficiare del ristorante ricevuto in eredità, due amici d'infanzia devono rispettare una condizione: essere sposati. I due iniziano la ricerca della loro anima gemella.

programme.title: The Surrogacy Trap
programme.desc: Dopo aver perso la speranza di concepire un figlio da soli, Christy e Mitch si rivolgono alla maternità surrogata nella speranza di creare la famiglia perfetta. Tuttavia, la loro fiducia viene rapidamente scossa quando scoprono che la giovane donna potrebbe non essere così perfetta come pensavano all'inizio.

programme.title: Amore a quattro mani
programme.desc: Quando a Kacey Cooke, straordinaria food blogger con un seguito impressionante, viene offerta l'opportunità di scrivere il suo libro di cucina, la coglie al volo... L'unico problema è che in realtà non sa cucinare.

programme.title: Sogno Di Una Notte Di Mezza Eta'
programme.desc: Daniel è felicemente sposato con sua moglie, ma ha due problemi: la sua fervida fantasia e il suo miglior amico Patrick, che durante una cena presenta agli amici la sua giovane “fiamma”, questo porterà Daniel a sognare ad occhi aperti e non distinguere la realtà dalla fantasia.

programme.title: L'atelier dei miei sogni
programme.desc: La stilista Skye gira con il suo "furgoncino della moda", ma non è in condizione di guidare e gestire l'attività da sola. L'aiuto arriva sotto l'improbabile forma dell'affascinante imprenditore Kevin. Lavorando insieme, Skye e Kevin scoprono di avere in comune più di quanto pensassero...

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: A Parigi, Grace e le sue amiche sono in un albergo di lusso, quando una di loro viene scambiata per una ricca ereditiera. Neanche il tempo di chiarire, che già sono verso Monte Carlo…

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artista trova improvvisamente la sua vita sconvolta quando la sua mostra d'arte viene cancellata e la sua fidanzata modella lo abbandona. Costretto a trasferirsi in un palazzo fatiscente, incontra pazzoidi, una donna di mezza, una prostituta matta e un dongiovanni spagnolo.

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis torna nella sua città natale per aprire una location per matrimoni, solo per affrontare l'opposizione del suo ex fidanzato Will Mason e degli altri locali.

programme.title: Finding Love in San Antonio
programme.desc: A una chef viene offerta la possibilità di lavorare in giro per l'Europa, ma teme di fare la scelta sbagliata per sua figlia, poiché la ragazza è legata alla città San Antonio, Texas. Tuttavia, gli affari del suo ristorante non vanno a gonfie vele.

programme.title: Un fidanzato in regalo
programme.desc: Callie è un'appassionata imprenditrice single che gestisce un'emergente attività di catering. Preoccupati che possa rimanere sola, i genitori le organizzano degli appuntamenti al buio per presentarle dei papabili pretendenti.

programme.title: Addestramento DAmore
programme.desc: Quando una scrittice di romanzi incontra un uomo della Marina, per una ricerca per il suo prossimo libro, viene colpita dalla sua forte personalità. Sceglierà di sposare l'uomo che pensava di amare o la versione reale del suo personaggio fittizio?

programme.title: Amore a Cedar Creek
programme.desc: Allison Sawyer è una giornalista che scrive del suo autore preferito che ha basato tutti i suoi romanzi sul bellissimo Clybourne Ranch. Lì incontra Hank che gestisce il posto da anni. Mentre Allison scrive, diventa anche molto più vicina a Hank...

programme.title: Il miracolo della Carinzia
programme.desc: Quando la piccola Kathi viene ricoverata in ospedale, è clinicamente morta. Il chirurgo Markus la salverà?

programme.title: Ritratto d'amore
programme.desc: Abbandonata dall'artista di punta, la curatrice di una mostra scopre lo straordinario talento di un ...

programme.title: Dolce settembre
programme.desc: Dopo che Rebecca è scappata dal suo ex, esce a bere qualcosa e incontra Bruno, un operatore telefonico.

programme.title: La madre della sposa
programme.desc: Prima che Lisa e il suo fidanzato Hrvoje possano sposarsi, devono fare i conti con le differenze culturali.

programme.title: Gara d'amore
programme.desc: Sophie è stata condannata al servizio comunitario in un centro per disabili. Qui incontra Georg: un incubo.

programme.title: Milk
programme.desc: Attivista del movimento dei diritti degli omosessuali. Amico. Amante. Unificatore. Politico. Combattente. Icona. Ispiratore. Eroe. La sua vita ha cambiato la storia, e il suo coraggio ha cambiato la vita di tante persone.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Jagoda: fragole al supermarket
programme.desc: Jagoda ("Fragola"), lavora in un supermarket e sogna di incontrare il grande amore. Contrariamente alla sua collega Ljubica, più attraente, a trent'anni passati Jagoda è sfortunata con gli uomini. Il giorno che l'amica ottiene un appuntamento con il bel vicino di casa di Jagoda, l'ispettore di polizia Nebojsa, la giovane scoppia e sfoga la sua frustrazione su un'anziana signora, buona cliente del negozio, che viene insultata e addirittura buttata fuori dalla stessa Jagoda. Il giorno seguente avviene qualcosa che cambierà la vita di Jagoda: entra nel supermarket un guerriero in tuta mimetica, armato fino ai denti, che prende tutti in ostaggio. Jagoda e Ljubica sono attratte dall'uomo che rifiuta di parlare con i poliziotti normali e vuole negoziare solo con un commando speciale, alla cui guida c'è Nebojsa.

programme.title: Scacco pazzo
programme.desc: Antonio, pochi giorni prima di sposarsi, è vittima di un incidente stradale che lo porta a regredire ad uno stadio infantile. Suo fratello maggiore Valerio si ritrova così a doversi prender cura di lui e per farlo deve ricorrere ad assurdi stratagemmi: travestendosi ora da mamma, ora da papà, non solo asseconda la demenza puerile di Antonio, ma rinfocola le relazioni di famiglia che sembravano sepolte. Marianna, fidanzata di Valerio, si intromette tra i due per cercare di dar loro una mano, ma…

programme.title: Il Gigante Pidocchio
programme.desc: Gaspare è vitale e ottimista. Sogna in grande, come spesso accade a chi non ha nulla. È sensibile a temi come l'ambiente, la cultura e il cinema. È un giovane pastore che tenta di evadere dalla dura e piatta quotidianità che lo attanaglia, affrontando la vita con ironia e mettendosi in gioco in tutti i modi. E col sorriso, tra citazioni impossibili, il pastore diventa attore in un film senza pecore....

programme.title: 10 canoe
programme.desc: Un gioco di scatole cinesi che inizia con un carrello aereo sulla palude australiana, attraversa foreste di alberi altissimi e terra fangosa, passando per specchi d'acqua coperti di ninfee su cui si riflette il cielo al tramonto. La voce narrante è quella di un aborigeno che si dice ormai parte delle infinite gocce d'acqua di quella palude, crogiuolo dei suoi antenati. Di passato in passato, la storia è quella di un suo avo che, mentre insegna al nipote l'arte di costruire canoe, gli tramanda le vicende della loro famiglia. Amori, passioni, gelosie, guerre, religioni e stregonerie.

programme.title: Fughe da fermo
programme.desc: Tratto dall'omonimo romanzo dello stesso Edoardo Nesi, il film racconta il disagio esistenziale e la mancanza di ideali di un gruppo di ragazzi che reagisce al vuoto da cui si sente circondato organizzando atti di rivolta. È solo la trasgressione a far sentire 'vivi' Fede e i suoi amici, che compiono gli atti più bizzarri con il solo scopo di dare un senso alla loro esistenza.

programme.title: Deuce Bigalow: European Gigolo
programme.desc: Deuce Bigalow (Rob Schneider) è tornato a darsi da fare. Letteralmente. Quando l'ex pappone di Deuce T.J. Hicks (Eddie Griffin) è implicato negli omicidi dei più grandi gigolo d'Europa, Deuce deve tornare al lavoro per riabilitare l'immagine dell'amico. Tuttavia il gigolo dovrà affrontare una spietata competizione rappresentata dalla Lega Europea dei Prosti-Tipi. Tentando di fare la corte ad una schiera di nuovi, strani clienti, tenterà di indagare sulla scomparsa degli altri gigolo. L'indagine arriva ad una svolta quando Deuce partecipa al 73° Concorso per Gigolo, spingendo il maligno colpevole a venire allo scoperto in questo sfrontato seguito alla precedente pellicola di successo.

programme.title: Indovina Perché Ti Odio
programme.desc: Donny (Adam Sandler Jack e Jill), divenuto padre durante l'adolescenza, alleva da solo il figlio Todd (Andy Samberg Amici di letto) fino a quando, compiuti 18 anni, Todd decide di interrompere ogni rapporto con il padre. Ma, dopo anni di assenza, Donny inaspettatamente piomba in casa di Todd alla vigilia delle sue nozze con la bella Jamie (Leighton Meester The Roommate - Il terrore ti dorme accanto), e nel tentativo disperato di riallacciare i rapporti con il figlio è costretto ad affrontare le conseguenze dei suoi fallimenti paterni. Il film vede la partecipazione straordinaria del rapper Vanilla Ice, di Susan Sarandon (Thelma & Louise) e di James Caan (Agente Smart - Casino totale).

programme.title: Papà, ho trovato un amico
programme.desc: Questa sarà un'estate piena per l'undicenne Vera Sultenfuss (Anna Chlumsky), col suo primo bacio, la sua prima cotta e il suo primo passo verso la crescita. Vera, il cui miglior amico è il timido Thomas J. (Macaulay Culkin), vive in una famiglia eccentrica il cui padre vedovo è un impresario di pompe funebri, Harry (Dan Aykroyd).

programme.title: Il mio primo bacio
programme.desc: Ritorna il cast originale di ‘Papà, ho trovato un amico' per altre avventure di Vera Sultenfuss (Anna Chlumsky). Siamo nel 1974, Vera ha 13 anni e suo padre (Dan Aykroyd) è sposato con Shelly (Jamie Lee Curtis), ora incinta. Quando Vera deve scrivere un tema sulla madre, il padre la lascia andare a Los Angeles per ricercarne il passato.

programme.title: Riuscirà l'avvocato Franco Benenato a sconfiggere il suo acerrimo nemico il pretore Ciccio De Ingras?
programme.desc: Il pretore Ciccio, stanco dell'avv. Benenato, dopo il trasferimento di questi, si sente meglio finché a Milano non trova una sorpresa

programme.title: La gatta da pelare
programme.desc: Mara e Stefano hanno alcuni problemi: lei va dallo psicoanalista Maraldi, lui lo minaccia e lo "uccide" nei fumetti

programme.title: Il casinista
programme.desc: Il comico Marullo spinge l'amico Casciotta a scrivere storie reali, scatenando una serie di disavventure.

programme.title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
programme.desc: Due portieri siciliani fermano il piano di Goldfoot per scatenare una guerra, ma finiscono prigionieri in Siberia

programme.title: Tutti a squola
programme.desc: Un professore all'antica finisce in galera per droga e guadagna popolarità tra gli studenti

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: Nonno Scatenato
programme.desc: Alla morte della nonna, Jason e suo nonno Dick partono per il viaggio più selvaggio della loro vita. Tra feste, risse da bar e una serata epica di karaoke, le imminenti nozze di Jason saranno messe a rischio dall'irrefrenabilità del nonno.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Quando Theresa porta il fidanzato Simon Green a casa per il 25° anniversario di matrimonoi dei genitori, dimentica di menzionare un piccolo dettaglio, è bianco. Deciso a rompere il fidanzamento di sua figlia, Percy Jones ci dimostra che i padri non sono sempre saggi.

programme.title: Totò, Fabrizi e i giovani d'oggi
programme.desc: Il cavalier Cocozza e il ragionier D'Amore hanno in comune solo una parlantina inarrestabile e una potente vocazione polemica. I due, acerrimi nemici, negano il consenso alle nozze dei loro figli che le proveranno tutte per riuscire a sposarsi. Ci riusciranno?

programme.title: I nostri mariti
programme.desc: Tre episodi diretti da tre registi d'eccezione come Luigi Filippo D'Amico, Dino Risi e Luigi Zampa che raccontano una storia d'amore fuori da ogni schema, un'eredità difficile da ottenere e un adulterio facilitato dal carcere.

programme.title: Company Man
programme.desc: Per evitare la moglie petulante, un insegnante si finge agente segreto della CIA e viene reclutato per rovesciare la dittatura di Fidel Castro a Cuba.

programme.title: Abe
programme.desc: Un ragazzo unisce le culture della sua famiglia nei piatti che impara a preparare insieme ad uno chef di Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Knight Of Shadows
programme.desc: Pu Songling è un leggendario cacciatore di demoni a cui viene chiesto di indagare sulle sparizioni di alcune ragazze del villaggio. Quando scopre che i crimini sono stati commessi da delle entità malvagie, Pu Songling combatte contro i demoni.

programme.title: Lillo e Greg: The Movie
programme.desc: Una collezione antologica delle migliori scenette comiche firmate da Lillo e Greg, in compagnia di tanti famosi colleghi. Un concentrato di ironia e musica dai tratti surreali e farseschi.

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: Messalina
programme.desc: Con Belinda Lee, Messalina intreccia seduzione e potere nella Roma imperiale tra passioni e congiure.

programme.title: Robin, frecce, fagioli e karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Golia e il cavaliere mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: L'arciere nero
programme.desc: Nel cuore del Medioevo, un abile arciere combatte contro tirannia e ingiustizie, guidando la ribellione del popolo tra agguati, duelli e intrighi di corte. Tra eroismo e vendetta, la sua lotta diventa simbolo di libertà.

programme.title: Genoveffa di Brabante
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: Thompson 1880
programme.desc: Ray Thompson, giovane e indigente, raggiunge Desert Spring, portando una valigia in cima al suo mulo. Una banda guidata da Brady utilizza mezzi apparentemente legali per impedire a chiunque di commerciare e sfrutta per sé tutte le possibilità della città.

programme.title: Ringo, il cavaliere solitario
programme.desc: Bill Anderson e la sua banda di ex confederati stanno terrorizzando la città di Springfield e dintorni, prosciugandola di ogni ricchezza. Dignitari locali chiamano l'agenzia Pinkerton per aiutare.

programme.title: Le colline blu
programme.desc: Tre cowboy, scambiati per membri di una banda di fuorilegge, sono implacabilmente inseguiti da una squadra.

programme.title: Una pistola per cento croci!
programme.desc: Dopo che un irlandese viene ucciso nel West, suo figlio Jimmy cerca vendetta ma viene ucciso a sua volta. Django (o Sartana) scopre la verità tramite una lettera della sorella di Jimmy, Jessica, e parte alla ricerca degli assassini. Tra rapimenti, torture e scontri, Django cerca giustizia, giustificando le cento croci sulla sua pistola.

programme.title: Indio Black, sai che ti dico: Sei un gran figlio di…
programme.desc: Durante la rivoluzione messicana, il pistolero Sabata trama per rubare oro da un colonnello austriaco.

programme.title: Il segno del coyote
programme.desc: Per vendicare i torti ai messicani, il figlio di un barone si finge collaboratore, ma è El Coyote.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: I sette del Texas
programme.desc: Il ricco texano Clifford, in viaggio per salvare la moglie, affronta minacce dai nativi.

programme.title: Stelle del Grande Schermo
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar
programme.desc: Un affascinante documentario sul più grande strumentista della storia del rock, Jimi Hendrix, morto nel 1970.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar
programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia del re del pop, Elvis Presley, fino alla sua improvvisa morte nel 1977.

programme.title: Rock Legends
programme.desc: Scopri la vita e l'impatto culturale di queste leggendarie icone musicali, tra interviste e performance.
